title: Pure Star Seraph
summary: Dumon's Star Seraph archetype is an explosive 3-material Rank 4 LIGHT Fairy Xyz engine built around the iconic 'Stick and Chair' duo: Star Seraph Scepter and Star Seraph Sovereignty! When you Normal or Special Summon Star Seraph Scepter, Scepter activates as Chain Link 1 to search a Star Seraph monster, and Star Seraph Sovereignty in your hand chains as Chain Link 2 to Special Summon itself and draw 1 card (and if that drawn card is a Star Seraph, you can immediately Special Summon it too!). Overlaying Scepter + Sovereignty + a 3rd Level 4 Star Seraph (Scale or Scout) into a 3-material Rank 4 Xyz (Number 102: Star Seraph Sentry, Stellarknight Delteros, or Number 104: Masquerade) triggers Scepter's bonus Xyz Material effect to target 1 other card on the field, destroy it, AND draw 1 more card!

allow.Summoner Monk: Level 4 Spellcaster starter: discards 1 Spell Card to Special Summon 'Star Seraph Scepter' directly from your Deck—immediately triggering Scepter to search Sovereignty AND providing a Level 4 body alongside Scepter and Sovereignty for a 1-card 3-material Rank 4 Xyz!
allow.Seventh Tachyon: Reveals 'Number 102: Star Seraph Sentry' (Rank 4 LIGHT Fairy) in your Extra Deck to add ANY Level 4 LIGHT or Fairy monster ('Star Seraph Scepter' or 'Star Seraph Sovereignty'!) from your Deck to your hand while locking your Extra Deck to Xyz Monsters!
allow.Seventh Ascension: Adds 'Seventh Tachyon' or 'Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force' from your Deck to your hand.
allow.Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force: Upgrades Rank 4 'Number 102: Star Seraph Sentry' into Dumon's Rank 5 boss 'Number C102: Archfiend Seraph' and steals an opponent's Xyz Material.
allow.Call of the Haunted: Continuous Trap that revives 'Star Seraph Scepter' from your GY during either player's turn—re-triggering Scepter's search AND triggering Star Seraph Sovereignty in your hand!
allow.Stellarknight Delteros: Rank 4 LIGHT Xyz (3 Level 4 monsters): when you Xyz Summon Delteros using Star Seraph Scepter + 2 Level 4s, Delteros's continuous effect ('While this card has Xyz Material, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when you Normal or Special Summon a monster(s)') makes Scepter's on-Xyz-Summon pop + draw 1 completely UNRESPONDABLE!
allow.Number 104: Masquerade: Rank 4 LIGHT Spellcaster Xyz (3 Level 4 monsters): triggers Scepter's on-summon pop + draw 1, and detaches 1 material during the Battle Phase to negate an opponent's monster effect and halve their LP!
allow.Bujintei Tsukuyomi: Rank 4 LIGHT Xyz (2 Level 4 LIGHT monsters) that draws 2 cards.
allow.Constellar Ptolemy M7: Rank 6 LIGHT Xyz that can rank up directly over Stellarknight Delteros on a later turn to bounce a monster from the field or GY (recycling Star Seraph Scepter back to your hand!).

main: Star Seraph Scepter

Core Level 4 LIGHT Fairy starter ('Stick'): when Normal or Special Summoned, adds ANY 'Star Seraph' monster (except Scepter) from your Deck to your hand; and an Xyz Monster that was Summoned using 3 or more monsters, including this card on the field, as materials gains the effect: 'When it is Xyz Summoned: You can target 1 other card on the field; destroy it, and if you do, you can draw 1 card'!
Star Seraph Sovereignty

Core Level 4 LIGHT Fairy extender ('Chair'): cannot be used as Xyz Material except for an Xyz Summon that uses 3 or more monsters as materials; if you Normal or Special Summon a 'Star Seraph' monster(s), you can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card—then if that drawn card is a 'Star Seraph' monster, you can Special Summon it too!
Star Seraph Scale

Core Level 4 LIGHT Fairy extender: when Special Summoned (such as by Scout, Sovereignty, or Call of the Haunted!), Special Summons 1 'Star Seraph' monster from your hand, then places 1 LIGHT monster from your GY on top of your Deck (stacking a Star Seraph on top of your Deck so Sovereignty's draw effect is guaranteed to draw and Special Summon it!); and gives a 3+ material Xyz a once-per-turn draw when the opponent Special Summons from hand!
Star Seraph Scout
Level 4 LIGHT Fairy starter: when Normal Summoned, Special Summons 1 'Star Seraph' monster from your hand (summoning Scepter or Scale to trigger their effects and Sovereignty!).
Star Seraph Sword
Level 4 LIGHT Fairy: sends 1 'Star Seraph' monster from your hand to the GY once per turn to gain its original ATK until the End Phase.
Summoner Monk

1-card 3-material Rank 4 starter: discards 1 Spell to Special Summon Star Seraph Scepter directly from your Deck (Scepter searches Sovereignty -> Sovereignty summons itself and draws 1 -> Monk + Scepter + Sovereignty overlay into Delteros or Number 102!).
Seventh Tachyon
Reveals Number 102: Star Seraph Sentry in your Extra Deck to add Star Seraph Scepter or Star Seraph Sovereignty from your Deck to your hand.
Seventh Ascension
Adds Seventh Tachyon or Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force from your Deck to your hand.
Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force
Ranks up Number 102: Star Seraph Sentry into Number C102: Archfiend Seraph.
Call of the Haunted
Revives Star Seraph Scepter or Star Seraph Scale during either player's turn to trigger their on-Special-Summon effects and Sovereignty in your hand!
extra: Dumon's signature Rank 4 LIGHT Fairy Xyz boss (3 Level 4 LIGHT monsters; 2500 ATK): once per turn detaches 1 material to target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, halve its ATK, and negate its effects; if this card would be destroyed, you can detach all of its Xyz Materials instead!

Dumon's signature Rank 5 LIGHT Fairy Chaos Xyz boss (2900 ATK): if it would be destroyed, detaches 2 materials instead; if its last material is detached, burns your opponent for 1500 damage; and while Number 102 is attached, detaches 1 material to reduce an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 and negate its effects!

Rank 4 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (3 Level 4 monsters): while it has Xyz Material, your opponent CANNOT activate cards or effects when you Special Summon—making Star Seraph Scepter's on-Xyz-Summon pop + draw 1 completely immune to Ash Blossom, Veiler, or Baronne/negates!

Rank 4 LIGHT Spellcaster Xyz (3 Level 4 monsters; 2700 ATK): triggers Scepter's pop + draw 1 on Xyz Summon, and detaches 1 material during battle to negate an opponent's monster effect and send half their LP!
Rank 6 LIGHT Xyz that stacks over Delteros to bounce a monster from the field or GY back to the hand.
Rank 4 LIGHT Xyz (2 Level 4 LIGHT monsters) for emergency 2-material hands.
